test_temp_set_env: test the temp_set_env context manager to temporarily override environment variables
test_env_override: test the envs.SGLANG_TEST_RETRACT.override context manager to temporarily override an env var value
test_env_get_set_clear: test the Envs descriptor get, set, clear, and is_set methods for reading and writing environment variables

test_envs_instance: test the global envs singleton instance that provides typed access to all SGLANG environment variables
